name: Piedmont Electrical Distributors of Greenville, Inc.
old_description: For over four decades, we’ve been the choice for quality electrical supplies and reliable service. Though we’ve grown, we remain a family-owned business in Greenville, SC. We’re dedicated to building strong relationships and providing the same personal service our customers have counted on since 1985.
about:
Piedmont Electrical Distributors of Greenville, Inc. was founded in 1985 in Greenville, South Carolina, by Tim Franke and his partner with the goal of becoming the leading electrical supplier for the region's construction and industrial markets. The business remains family-owned; Tim and his wife Francine led the company for years before their son Josh Franke took over as owner.

The company operates a 36,000-square-foot warehouse stocking a broad range of electrical products including circuit breakers, lighting fixtures, conduit, and wire. It serves customers across South Carolina, North Carolina, and Georgia through both delivery and a counter service for immediate pick-up. When items are not in stock, the team sources them quickly to minimize project downtime.

Piedmont Electrical primarily serves contractors and industrial facilities in the Upstate region. Its customer base includes on-site superintendents, electrical contractors, and industrial maintenance teams who rely on the distributor for timely material delivery and responsive communication. Testimonials from field supervisors highlight the company's willingness to deliver to job sites over an hour away and to accommodate last-minute order changes.

The company emphasizes its founding commitment to service and long-term relationships over transactional sales. It differentiates itself through fast delivery, reliable sourcing, and personable sales support, maintaining a team of outside and inside sales representatives, warehouse staff, and administrative personnel to keep projects moving.
